caseName: United States v. Dalles Military Road Co.
caseNameFull: United States v. Dalles Military Road Company
summary: Appeal from the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. Assistant Attorney General Parker for appellants., Mr. James K. Kelly fbr appellees.

opinions.author: Brewer
opinions.text:
Brewer, J.

The questions in this ease are substantially the same as those in No. 1073, United States v. California & Oregon Land Company. It is unnecessary, therefore, to state the facts in detail, and it is sufficient to say that the same decree of affirmance will be entered.
